plugins.name: Ownship
plugins.description: Shows the jet's own position from its navigation data, with a trail and a warning when the data stops.

plugins.name: Ground threats
plugins.description: Loads the Ground Threat List (GTL), shows it on the map, and walks the user through position updates.

plugins.name: Jet data transfer
plugins.description: Reviews the differences between the tablet and the jet and sends them over a simulated data transfer.
